title: Returning to New York in May 1951
summary: He stayed in Paris until May 1951, then went straight from the boat to Dizzy's recording of "The Champ".

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well then, so did you go back to the Royal Roost with Tadd then?
No, no. No, I stayed over here from that festival on. I stayed two years. I stayed till '51.

And just -- I got off the boat, and went straight to the studio. Someone was -- I met someone who was telling me that Diz is recording. So he was recording at that time, "The Champ," with Art Blakey, and I walked right in the studio and everybody fell out. "You mean you're back?"
So that was in '51, May, '51. Then, during the five years I stayed home.
